data.narrative:
Orbem is a Series B-stage biotech and health company that has raised €55.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four private companies in the same sector and stage vicinity, supplemented by three public biotech comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) used for directional context only.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. The four private comparables—Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M, Series B)—yield a median valuation of $3.5B. This range spans from $539M at the low end to $10.3B at the high end, reflecting material variance within the cohort. Public biotech comps trade at a 5.5x median price-to-sales multiple, but this method cannot be applied without Orbem's disclosed revenue, which is not available for private-stage targets.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.9B to $4.0B, centered on the peer median of $3.5B. Key uncertainties include the composition of the peer set—only one direct Series B comparator exists in the sample—and the absence of revenue or profitability data to ground relative valuation metrics. The wide dispersion in peer valuations ($539M to $10.3B) reflects heterogeneity in technology maturity and capital efficiency within the frontier biotech space.
